campaign_name: PR-BR Continuation 19 — Hard-Authority Boundary and Contract Canonicalization Closeout
purpose: Reject ungrounded authoritative operational rules before C18 seals them, and canonicalize source follow-ups and social questions. Four focused live turns. No independent smoke. No 4x10 gate. PR-BR remains open.
executive_summary: C18's seal-or-retry lifecycle is unchanged. Ungrounded schedules, access rules, and official levies are hard-invalid and retry once. Grounded rules, NPC rumors, and bounded incidental detail stay valid. The 267-test band passed, including the 16-turn historical replay. Four live turns kept exact accepted text and emitted no unauthorized world rule. Two live contracts were not canonical: a source follow-up stayed on content, and an unbound ask of an unlisted merchant sealed the safe line. READY FOR ANOTHER INDEPENDENT 10-TURN SMOKE: NO. READY FOR FULL SYNTHETIC GATE: NO. HUMAN PLAYTEST: NOT AUTHORIZED. HEAD d31beb7d73dd4fda0f22184a6a69b947b5f470ff, uncommitted.
